text.body: <1> ekaṃ vāpi kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet devadvāre naro yadi | sampādayettāvataiva sa tu muktiṃ caturvidhām||1 mukhena śrīharirgeyo harirgeyo mukhena ca| yad harismaraṇājjātaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ gaṇayennu kaḥ||2 saṃsārastho'pi jantuścet tvarate nāma jihvayā| taratīti māhāghoṣaḥ śrutiśāstreṣu sarvadā||3 jñāneśvaro vadatyevaṃ vyāsasaṅketapālanāt| pāṇḍavānāṃ gṛhaṃ sākṣād dvārakeśaḥ samāgataḥ||4 <2> jñānābhidhaścaturvede ṣaṭśāstre kāraṇābhidhaḥ|aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu gīyate harireva ca||1 jagato manthanād grāhyo śrīharirnavanītavat|tyaja vyarthāṃ kathāṃ vyarthaṃ vimārgagamanaṃ tyaja||2 harirātmā caika eva vyāpto jīve śive samaḥ|durgameṣu vimārgeṣu tvaṃ vṛthā mā manaḥ kṛthāḥ||3 harirvaikuṇṭharūpo'yaṃ jñānadevena paṭhyate| otaprotaśca sarvatra śrīhariḥ sampradṛśyate||4 <3> triguṇaṃ sārahīnaṃ syāt sārabhūtaṃ tu nirguṇam|sārāsāravicāro'yaṃ haripāṭhe vimṛśyate||1 saguṇaṃ vā nirguṇaṃ vā guṇasambandhataḥ smṛtam|vinā hariṃ tatra cittaṃ prasaktaṃ cennirarthakam||2 avyaktaḥ śrīharirhyeṣa nirākārastathaiva ca| carācaraṃ yato jātaṃ tameva śrīhariṃ bhaja||3 rāmakṛṣṇasmṛtirdhyāne jñānadevasya mānase|anantajanmabhiścaivaṃ puṇyaṃ sampādyate naraiḥ||4 <4> bhāvena rahitā bhaktirmuktirbhaktiṃ vinā tathā| balaṃ vinā kāryaśaktiriti vyarthaṃ prajalpanam||1 acirādeva devānāṃ prasādaḥ syāt kathaṃ mayi| iti yanmuhuḥ prayatase, vyarthaṃ tat , tiṣṭha niścalaḥ||2 divāniśaṃ prapañce'smin yatase yatase muhuḥ| kimālambanamāsthāya bhajase śrīhariṃ na ca||3 bhāṣate jñānadevo yat kartavyaḥ śrīharerjapaḥ| tenaiva syānniścayena prapañcasya prabādhanam||4 <5> na yogavidhinā siddhirna yāgavidhināpi vā| dharmā ete dambharūpā vṛthopādhaya eva ca||1 na bhāvena vinā devo na ca sandehanāśanam| aparokṣānubhūtirna vidyate sadguruṃ vinā||2 nātapaskasya devaḥ syādadāturnaiva sampadaḥ| ekānte premasaṃvādaṃ vinā brūyād hitaṃ nu kaḥ||3 prabhāṣate jñānadevo dṛṣṭānto nātra sādhakaḥ| taraṇopāya labhyeta sādhūnāmeva saṅgatau||4 <6> tiṣṭhet sa nirahaṅkāraḥ sādhunā yaḥ prabodhitaḥ| svādhiṣṭhāne samaraso jāyate'nubhavena saḥ||1 edhate ca yathā jyotiḥ karpūrasya svake sthale| dīptaṃ punaḥ samāptaṃ tat tasminneva sthale bhavet ||2 haribhaktasya caraṇaṃ svayaṃ mokṣaḥ samāgataḥ| bhāgyena bhūṣito bhaktaḥ sādhūnāṃ kiṅkarastathā||3 jñānadevasya manasi ruciḥ sādhusamāgame| jane vane cātmatatve tenaiva haridarśanam||4 <7> abhaktāḥ śailatulyāni pāpāni kurvate tathā| bhavanti tāni pāpāni vajralepadṛḍhāni ca||1 nāsti yeṣāṃ harau bhaktirabhaktāḥ patitāśca te| na bhajante hariṃ tasmādete durbhāginaḥ smṛtāḥ||2 vācālāste vṛthā jālaṃ vacanānāṃ vitanvate| naiteravāpyate lokaiḥ śrīhariḥ sadayo'pi san||3 jñānadevamatenātmā pramāṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ tathā| sarveṣāṃ hṛdaye pūrṇaścaikaḥ saṃnivasatyayam||4 <8> samprāpyate cittalayaḥ sādhūnāṃ saṅgatau tataḥ| śrīpatiḥ samprāpaṇīya etenaiva pathā dhruvam||1 rāmakṛṣṇetivacanaṃ jīvabhāva iti smṛtaḥ| śivasyātmeti vikhyāto rāmanāmajapo hyayam||2 ekatattvātmakaharau nāma sādhanamucyate| sādhayanti ca ye tat tān dvaitabandho na bādhate||3 nāmāmṛtarasāsvāde vaiṣṇavānāṃ parā ruciḥ| dīrghajīvanavidyā yā sādhitā sā tu yogibhiḥ||4 nāmoccārasya dṛḍhatā prahlāde bālya eva ca| uddhavasyopadeśaṃ tu śrīkṛṣṇo'kuruta svayam||5 jñānadevo vakti nāma sādhanaṃ sulabhaṃ smṛtam| jānāti kaścidevaṃ yat kaṭhinaṃ sādhanāntaram ||6 <9> na rāme na ca vā kṛṣṇe saṃraktaṃ yasya mānasam| apaviṣṇu japastasya vyartho, jñānaṃ vṛthā ca tat|| 1 jāto'pyadvaitamārgaṃ yo na jānīte sa durbhagaḥ| kathaṃ rāme'thavā kṛṣṇe praveśastasya sambhavet||2 na yairgurodhigataṃ jñānaṃ dvaitavimardanam| saṅkīrtanaṃ harernāmnāṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ nu sambhavet||3 jñāneśvaro vadati yad, tad dhyānaṃ saguṇaṃ smṛtam| yasya nāmnāṃ pāṭhato'yaṃ prapañcaḥ śāntimṛcchati||4 <10> triveṇīsaṅgame nānātīrtheṣvaṭanameva vā| cittaṃ na cennāmajape, sarvaṃ tadbhramaṇaṃ vṛthā||1 nāmato yastu vimukho, mūrtimatpāpameva saḥ| uddhartuṃ tādṛśaṃ pāpaṃ nālaṃ ko'pi vinā harim||2 purāṇeṣu prasiddhaḥ sa vālmīkiridamuktavān| harināmasmaraṇato bhuvanatrayamuddharet||3 vadatīdaṃ jñānadevaḥ śrīharernāma yo japet| viśuddhā jāyate tasya sarvā kulaparamparā|| <11> uccāreṇa harernāmnāmanantāḥ pāparāśayaḥ| kṣaṇamātreṇaiva sarve vilayaṃ yāntyaśeṣataḥ||1 agninā saha saṃyogāt tṛṇamagnisamaṃ yathā| vinaśyati tathā pāpaṃ japato nāma śrīhareḥ||2 harirityayamuccāro mantraḥ sāmarthyavānayam| etasmānmantrato bhītā bhūtabādhā dravantyapi||3 jñānadevo bhāṣate yat samarthaḥ śrīharirmama| agamyaśca tathaivaiṣaḥ sarvopaniṣadāmapi||4 <12> tīrthairvratairvā niyamairna siddhirbhāvavarjitaiḥ| bhāvaśūnyaṃ vṛthopādhirūpametadaho janāḥ||1 vijñāyate ca vispaṣṭaṃ hastasthāmalakaṃ yathā| tathā bhāvabalenāyaṃ harirjñāyeta nānyathā||2 bhūmisthaḥ pāradakaṇo yathā yatnaśatairapi| na gṛhyate, sādhanānāṃ śatairapi tathā hariḥ||3 jñāneśvaro vadati yat, nivṛttirnirguṇo guruḥ| sa svarūpasthitiṃ pūrṇāmadadād hastayormama||4 <13> harau samādhirna vinā brahmātmasamatāsukham| na samādhirdvaitabuddhyā siddhyatītyavadhāryatām||1 na samādhiṃ vinā buddhervaibhavaṃ vidyate'param| ekena keśavenaiva labhyante sarvasiddhayaḥ||2 ṛddhiḥ siddhirnidhirvāpi tāvad vyarthā upādhayaḥ| yāvattasminparānande śrīharau nāsti mānasam||3 jñānadevo bhāṣate yat sarvadā haricintanāt| ramaṇīyaṃ samādhānaṃ yattadāsāditaṃ mayā||4 <14> manasā haripāṭhaṃ yo nityaṃ niyatasaṅkhyayā| kuryāttasya na bādhaḥ syāt kalitaḥ kālato'pi vā||1 rāmakṛṣṇajapo'nantataporāśisamo mataḥ| bhasmasāttena vṛndāni vṛjinānāṃ bhavanti ca||2 hare hare hare cemaṃ mantraṃ japati śaṅkaraḥ| mokṣaṃ te'pi prāpnuvanti mantrametaṃ japanti ye||3 jñāneśvaro vadatyevaṃ yat śrīnārāyaṇaprabhoḥ| nāmapāṭhānnijaṃ sthānamuttamaṃ prāptavānaham||4 <15> hariṇaikyaṃ tasya nāmno , dvaitaṃ nāmāntarasya ca| advaitaṃ haritannāmnorjānāti viralo janaḥ||1 samabuddhirjapāt ,sāmyaṃ harervijñāyate tayā| śrīharismaraṇātsiddhirśamasya ca damasya ca||2 sahasraraśmirādityo yathā sarvaprakāśakaḥ| acareṣu careṣvevaṃ rāma ekaḥprakāśate||3 vakti jñāneśvaraścitte nityaṃ me harisaṃsmṛtiḥ| tenāgrimebhyo janmabhyo jātaṃ mama vimocanam||4 <16> rāmakṛṣṇeti japanaṃ vāṇyāti sukaraṃ nṛṇām| tathāpi durlabho loke harināma japannaraḥ|| yaiḥ sādhitaścittalayo rāmakṛṣṇeti nāmasu| saṃsādhitā narairetaiḥ siddhayaḥ sakalā api||2 siddhirbuddhistathā dharmo harerete'nugāminaḥ| prapañcastho'pi satsaṅgānmanolayamavāpnuyāt||3 jñāneśo vakti me mudrā rāmakṛṣṇeti vāghṛdoḥ| ātmasvarūpā tenaiva jātā daśa diśo mama||4 <17> mukhena haripāṭhasya kīrtiṃ gāyati cennaraḥ| śarīraṃ tasya tannūnaṃ pavitraṃ saṃprajāyate||1 tapaso yanmahatpuṇyaṃ tadgātreṣu samāhitam| cirañjīvaḥ sa kalpānāṃ koṭīstenābhinandati||2 mātā pitā tathā bhrātā sagotrā bahuśastathā| santiṣṭhante sarva ete viṣṇurūpāścaturbhujāḥ||3 gūḍhagamyaṃ ca yajjñānaṃ tannivṛttiḥ kare mama| dattavān, tanmayā labdhamiti jñāneśabhāṣitam||4 <18> harivaṃśaḥ purāṇāni harināma ca kīrtanam| hariṃ vinā ca viṣayo yasmai ko'pi na rocate||1 narasya tasya lābho'yaṃ yad vaikuṇṭhaṃ samāpnuyāt | tīrthāṭanasya sarvasya phalaṃ cāpi labheta saḥ||2 manomārgeṇa yo yāto nāpnoti sa idaṃ sukham| haripāṭhe sthiro yastu sa dhanyo jāyate naraḥ||3 vakti jñāneśvaro nāmasaṅge me vidyate rasaḥ| rāmakṛṣṇaviṣayiṇī vartate me ruciḥ sadā|| 4 <19> sādhanānāṃ sāra eko nārāyaṇajapaḥ sadā| pramāṇamatra vedānāṃ tathopaniṣadāṃ vacaḥ ||1 japastapaḥ kriyā karma niyamo dharma eva vā| sarvametadvinā nāma vyarthamityavagamyatām||2 kalikāmāśritā bhṛṅgāstatraivāsaktamānasāḥ| haripāṭhāśritāstadvad harāvāsaktamānasāḥ||3 jñāneśasya vaco nāmamantraśāstraṃ balapradam| yannāmadhāriṇo gotraṃ kulaṃ ca yamavarjitam||4 <20> nāmasaṅkīrtanaṃ viṣṇorbhaktānāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtam| anantānantapāpānāmantasteṣāmajāyata||1 anantajanmatapasā nāmaikaṃ śrīhareḥ samam | haripāṭho'sti sugamo mārgeṣu sakaleṣu ca||2 yogo yāgaḥ kriyā dharmastathaivādharma eva ca| māyikaṃ sarvamevaitad , haripāṭhe vilīyate||3 vakti jñāneśvaro yajño yogo dharmastathā kriyā| harirūpaṃ sarvametad nāsti me niyamo'paraḥ||4 <21> nāmoccāre na niyamaḥ samayasyāsti kaścana| atra vaktustathā śroturuddhāra ubhayorapi||1 rāmakṛṣṇeti nāmedaṃ sarvadoṣāpahaṃ smṛtam| jīvānāṃ ca jaḍānāṃ ca harirekastu tārakaḥ||2 harināmoccāraṇena sārtheyaṃ rasanā bhavet| nāmadhārakasadbhāgyaṃ ko vā varṇayituṃ kṣamaḥ||3 jñāneśvaro vakti sāṅgo haripāṭhaḥ svabhāvataḥ| vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāntyanāyāsaṃ nāmadhārakapūrvajāḥ||4 <22> nityaṃ niyamato nāma smaranto durlabhā janāḥ| sa lakṣmīvallabhasteṣāṃ samīpe vidyate sadā||1 nārāyaṇa hare nāma ye japanti narāḥ sadā | teṣāṃ gṛhe sadā bhuktirmuktiścaiva caturvidhā||2 harināma vinā janma jānīta narako yathā| bhavitā tādṛśaḥ prāṇī yamalokātithirdhruvam||3 jñāneśo nāmamāhātmyaviṣaye pṛṣṭavān yadā| nivṛttiravadat ‘ nāma vyāpakaṃ gaganādapi '||4 <23> sapta pañca tathā trīṇi daśa caikatra melitam| melo'yaṃ bhāsate sarva ekatatvātmake harau||1 naivaṃ nāma, variṣṭhaṃ tanmārgeṣu sakaleṣu ca| na nāmasmaraṇe kaṣṭaṃ manāgapyanubhūyate||2 so'haṃ haṃsa iti prāṇe so'japājapasaṃjñitaḥ| tasminnapi jape nāmasmaraṇaṃ vidyate dhruvam||3 vakti jñāneśvaro vyarthaṃ jīvitaṃ nāmavarjitam| rāmakṛṣṇākhyamārgo'yamata ākramyate mayā||4 <24> japastapaḥ kriyā karma niyamo dharma eva vā| rāmaḥ sarvatreti śuddhabhāvotpādanahetukam||1 na santyājyastvayā bhāvaḥ sandehastyājya eva re| rāmakṛṣṇanāmaghoṣaḥ sarvadā kriyatāmare||2 jātirvittaṃ kulaṃ śīlaṃ gotraṃ te syātkathañcana| tathāpi bhāvayuktaḥ san tvarayā śrīhariṃ bhaja||3 jñāneśo vakti me dhyāne rāmakṛṣṇeti mānase| tena vaikuṇṭhabhuvane nivāso'sti sadā mama|| <25> na bhānaṃ na ca vābhānaṃ śrīharau vidyate kvacit| harināmajapāttasmānmokṣalābhaḥ sadā bhavet||1 nārāyaṇa hare nāmoccāro yatra tu vidyate| kalirvāpi ca kālo vā praveśaṃ tatra nārhataḥ||3 nāmaśakteḥ pramāṇaṃ tu vedā api vidanti na| kathaṃ tacca vijānīyuḥ sāmānyā jīvajantavaḥ||4 phalarūpo hareḥ pāṭha iti jñāneśvaroditam| tena vaikuṇṭharūpāśca deśāḥ sarve'bhavanmama||5 <26> nāmaikameva tatvaṃ tad dṛḍhaṃ dhāraya re manaḥ| kāruṇyabhāvo jāyeta tena tvadviṣaye harau||1 suvācaṃ nāma tad rāma kṛṣṇa govinda vāpi ca| vāṇyā sagadgadaṃ nāma tadeva prathamaṃ japa||2 nāmnaḥ parataraṃ tatvaṃ vidyate naiva cāparam| ataścānyena mārgeṇa gamanaṃ te nirarthakam||3 jñāneśo vakti mūkaḥ sandhṛtvā śrīharimantare| kṛtvā ca manaso mālāṃ hṛdi nityaṃ japāmyaham||4 <27> nāmni sarvasukhāsvāda iti ṣaṭśāstranirṇayaḥ| ato'rdhaghaṭikāṃ vāpi mā nāmavimukho bhava||1 saṃsāravyavahāro'sau mithyāsti sakalo'pi ca| gatāgataṃ vṛthā tatra harināma vinā bhavet||2 nāmamantrajapenaiva koṭipāpavināśanam| rāmakṛṣṇajape tasmātsaṅkalpaste dṛḍho bhavet||3 samāvṛṇu nijāṃ vṛttiṃ māyāṃ troṭaya cākhilām| indriyānunayānmā svaṃ gopayāsmācchamāddamāt||4 kāryā tīrthe vrate śraddhā, śāntyā karuṇayā tathā| dayayā caiva satkāryo hariḥ prāhuṇikastvayā||5 jñāneśasya pramāṇaṃ tajjñānamuktaṃ nivṛttinā| saṃjīvanasamādhiḥ sa haripāṭhena siddhyati||6 <28> bhavanti haripāṭhe'smin padyānāmekaviṃśatiḥ| viśvasya nāmasāmarthye jñāneśaracitāni ca||1 indrāyaṇīnadītīre nityaṃ paṭhati yo naraḥ| tatastasyādhikāraśca sarvathā jāyate dhruvam||2 ekāgramanasā caiva svasthacittena sādhakaḥ| sollāsaṃ ca tathā kuryānnāmasmaraṇamantare||3 jīvanasyāntime kāle saṅkaṭeṣu tathaiva ca| bahiścaivāntare caiva nibhālayati tānhariḥ||4 anubhūtamidaṃ naikaiḥ sādhubhiḥ sajjanaistathā| yaścālaso mandabuddhiḥ sa kathaṃ nu tarennaraḥ||5 nivṛttisadguroretat śrutvā premayutaṃ vacaḥ| anukṣaṇaṃ jñānadevaḥ santoṣaṃ paramāptavān||6
